in_greek.name: Σαλβίων
in_greek.meaning: Παράγεται από το 'σωτηρία' και σημαίνει σωτηρία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Σαλβίων προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'σωτηρία' που σημαίνει σωτηρία. Στον хristianισμό, το όνομα αυτό συμβολίζει τη σωτηρία και τη λύτρωση μέσω της πίστης στον Ιησού Χριστό. Είναι ένα όνομα που φέρει μέσα του τη χαρά και την ελπίδα της αιώνιας ζωής.

in_english.name: Salvion

Historically, names with similar roots have been used to signify a person's connection to their faith and their role as a beacon of hope within their community.

historical_references.reference: Saint Salvian of Marseilles was a bishop and monk in the 5th century. He is best known for his work 'De Gubernatione Dei' (On the Governance of God), which is a spiritual autobiography and a commentary on the Old Testament.

The name Salvion may have originated from Saint Salvian of Alba, a bishop and monk in the 6th century. He is known for his contributions to the spread of Christianity in northern Italy and for his Rule of Saint Salvian, which influenced later monastic rules such as the Rule of Saint Benedict.
